title: Sunday · Cedar, iii · the floor
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The third of twelve. The mill floor as forest: the alders of 2008 are trees now, the saw benches are stumps, the roof is canopy. A trail through it. Nobody on the trail.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the mill's interior as a forest floor — the saw benches gone to mossed stumps, the alders through the boards now forty feet tall, the half-gone roof become canopy. A trail. Light in shafts.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rust, a ruined mill interior transformed into a forest where the saw benches have become moss-covered stumps and alders reach a canopy where the roof was, a faint trail, shafts of light, no words

panels.name: The floor

panels.composition: Tier 2: a stump, close: the saw bench's iron still in it, the growth rings around the iron.
props: a stump with iron in it

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rust, close-up of a mossed stump with an old iron saw-bench fitting embedded in it and growth rings formed around the metal, no words
image.notes: The iron is real; the wood grew around it. The rule of the sequence.

panels.name: Iron

panels.composition: Tier 3: the trail going on into the trees where the loading dock was. The 1994 group photo's spot. Nobody. Held.
